entities.summary: Vientiane, a notable figure in the history of Laos, associated with Three Kingdoms and Siamese Domination (1826–1829). Preceded by Chao Anouvong Rebellion and Chao Anouvong's rebellion against Siam fails; Vientiane is razed and depopulated. Their legacy influenced Siamese Vassalage.
